Extract 64-dim encoder features for all samples (GAP-pooled)

Source: R/classify.R
extract_encoder_features.Rd

Runs each sample through the (frozen) encoder, applies global average pooling to its feature map, and stacks the result into an (N, 64) matrix suitable for use as input to a classical classifier.

Usage

extract_encoder_features(encoder, Z_list, device = "cpu")

Arguments

encoder

A pre-trained dms_encoder.

Z_list

List of preprocessed, padded intensity matrices.

device

"cpu" or "cuda".

Value

Numeric matrix with one row per sample, 64 columns.
